---
title: "xusupp"
---

## Description

Create and add variables to SUPP domain.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`invar`**

: Name of the variable to add to SUPP domain

  *Required:* Yes

**`idvar`**

: Name of the id variable

  *Required:* No

**`qlabel`**

: Text to be displayed in QLABEL variable

  *Required:* Yes

**`qorig`**

: Text to be displayed in QORIG variable

  *Required:* Yes

**`qeval`**

: Text to be displayed in QEVAL variable

  *Required:* No

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary datasets or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xusupp(dm,RACEOTH,qlabel=%str(Race,Other),qorig=CRF,qeval=,debug=N);
```
